# Minds Studio Product Guide

> Independent product walkthrough of https://minds.email, observed 2026-10-26. Not official documentation.

Minds Studio is an email-first multi-agent workspace. Users create persistent AI agents called Minds, give them identities, skills, apps, memory and project context, then delegate via chat, email or voice. Work is supervised through a task board and a dashboard showing status, time saved, energy/usage and spend.

Canonical files:
- README.md
- PRODUCT_OVERVIEW.md
- FEATURES.md
- USER_FLOWS.md
- ARCHITECTURE.md
- IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md
- feature-catalog.json
- llms-full.txt

Important terms:
- Mind: persistent, addressable AI agent.
- Project: private container for chats, files and tasks.
- Task board: human-supervised lifecycle.
- Energy: usage/budget abstraction.
- Discover: feed that can become private or recurring work.
- Pod: experimental grouped-agent workspace.
- Companion: integration surface for proactive/scheduled work.
